notes.title: Patch (Ver. 1.1.0) Release Announcement
notes.content:

notes.title: (TC/KR Ver.)The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki II - CRIMSON SiN- released!
notes.content:
[h3]The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki II -CRIMSON SiN- (subtitles: Traditional Chinese/Korean), the latest installment inThe Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki series, is available on Steam from January 26, 2023 at 00:00 (JST)! [/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/29655/_CRIMSON_SiN/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2113920/_CRIMSON_SiN/

The game features the unique battle system of its predecessors that switches seamlessly from field battles to command battles, in addition to the popular LGC Alignment system, which allows players to change their character’s three unique attributes (Law, Gray, and Chaos) according to their playstyle. Get ready to tackle The Legend of Heroes: Kuro no Kiseki II -CRIMSON SiN-’s various challenges that take place across the colorful Republic of Calvard!
[previewyoutube=AY6u07n73OI;full][/previewyoutube]
The Steam® version is also compatible with 21:9 ultra-wide monitors, allowing for a wider field of view. Compared to other versions, players can enjoy a unique advantage when attacking and defending against enemies in battle.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319640/ce0e71c9e8fe41bd813d8cba57d61b030fae0e03.jpg[/img]

[h3]Early Purchase Bonus[/h3]
[b][list]
[*] 10% OFF Standard and Digital Deluxe Editions (available thru February 1, 2023 at 23:59 JST)
[*] 3 bonus DLC items (available thru February 9, 2023 at 16:59 JST)[/list][/b]
[b]In addition to the 1-week discount starting from the official launch, the following bonus DLC items are included![/b]

[h3]Early Purchase Bonus DLC #1: Van’s Exclusive Mishy Suit Costume[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319640/91c2522623dd4cb10c4ede19924d59ded029aaa9.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319640/e42f5f52a5d8298e67a2064d3e22ed63c48e6c57.png[/img][/url]
The beloved mascot "Mishy" has arrived in the Republic of Calvard! The main character Van's costume can be changed to a loose-fitting "Mishy suit" for actors.
 
[h3]Early Purchase Bonus DLC #2: Holow Core Voice [R.A. Monitoring Target][/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319640/513234a6763c71f4174988654362ad7561e98dba.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319640/00dad8667083884bf7f86aaf040275d5692f688b.jpg[/img][/url]
The system voice of the tactical orbment Xipha can be changed to that of [R.A.], a mysterious figure under close watch by the CID, Calvard’s Central Intelligence Department.

[h3]Early Purchase Bonus DLC #3: Agnes’s Z-1 Queen (Agnes Ver.) Costume[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319640/f57e83420e06e7323195303e56abcfed177adf0d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42319640/afe53c04773a62dfd11575c753dbbd534c24d1d8.png[/img][/url]
When the Solutions Office team decided to compete in the Z-1 Grand Prix, their sponsor, Prince Sherid, took the liberty of designing the "Team SPRIGGAN" pit girl costume for Agnes.


※This bonus is available for both the Digital Standard and Digital Deluxe Editions.
※Please note that discount period and early purchase bonus DLC availability period are not the same.
※Please note that offer end time(s)/date(s) follows Japan Standard Time, not local time.
※Contents of bonus are subject to change without notice.

notes.title: Ver.1.0.2 Patch Release Notice (Aug 1)
notes.content:
・Improved the resolution of avatars in the conversation window and the costume preview when the display resolution is 4K or higher.

・All refresh rates that can be set on the display are now showed in the resolution options.

notes.title: Patch Release Notice (July 29)
notes.content:
-Fixed an issue with the setting tools that kept starting continuously when the location of the Windows User folder has been changed.

-Fixed an issue which the resolution settings were not properly displaying other than 1280x720 on some displays and could not be started in full screen.
